description: Autonomous self-improving 4x DGX Spark (GB10) MoA stack + LoRA loop (DSV4F router, Qwen3.6/Omni/TwoTower/Gemma). Hermes MoA routing, ~90% local, self-LoRA. Includes a SINGLE-SPARK recipe (all-Gemma-4: 31B brain + DiffusionGemma + 12B) to build the same on 1 GB10.
